body: The stack is starting to rhyme: policy funding → regional coordination → compute/platform investment → factory-domain data sharing. That sequence is more interesting than any robot demo because each layer can remove a different adoption bottleneck. Pero ang next signal must change category: from ecosystem formation to measured operations. Kapag may repeatable multi-site gains sa setup time, uptime, yield or unattended hours, saka natin puwedeng sabihing implementation trend—not announcement trend—ang umiinit.
